description: This header file defines string utility functions for converting strings to numbers and vice versa, as well as functions for string manipulation and validation such as IP address checks. It is part of the 'CcspCommonLibrary' component and provides string-related helper functions used across the project.

methods.name: AnscStrBufGetCharNum
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of a specific character in a string buffer.

methods.name: AnscStrGetCharNum
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of a specific character in a null-terminated string.

methods.name: AnscDupString
methods.description: Duplicates a string, allocating new memory.

methods.name: AnscMemUtilRealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory with specified new size.

methods.name: AnscValidStringCheck
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid (non-null and non-empty).

methods.name: AnscValidStringCheck2
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid and does not contain invalid characters.

methods.name: is_IpAddress
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: is_Ipv6_address
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: is_ValidHost
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hostname.

methods.name: is_ValidPort
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid port number.

methods.name: is_ValidIpAddressv4_port
methods.description: Validates if a string contains a valid IPv4 address with port.

methods.name: is_ValidIpAddressv6_port
methods.description: Validates if a string contains a valid IPv6 address with port.

methods.name: is_PrivateIp
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within private IP ranges.
